text:
Alex: FYI — noticed another cross-region egress splay this morning that triggered a retry storm for a subset of LB-backed services. Seen increased 5xx and client retries from eu-west->us-east path.
Maria: Ugh, is this the same signature as last week's incident?
Alex: Very similar. Routing table flip + a stale healthcheck causing LB to prefer a farther region temporarily. Logs look like: 
```
2026-03-23T08:02:11Z svc-proxy ERROR upstream connect failed, tls: handshake timeout
2026-03-23T08:02:11Z lb-proxy WARN route selected region=us-east latency=420ms
```
Sam: Can we pull the per-route egress histogram for the last 24h? suspect batching of retries from queued clients. Query I'll run: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{route=~"/api/.*",region!="us-east"}[5m])) by (region)`
Jordan: I'll take ownership of the remediation plan for the LB routing rule fix and coordinate rollout. Targeting a canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Lee: I'll own the runbook/update for the SRE oncall: add explicit guard for healthcheck stale states and a fast-fail policy. ETA EOD today for draft.
Maria: I can own telemetry/dashboards — will add a per-route cross-region retry gauge and an anomaly alert with pager threshold (5m rate > 0.5 rps per route).
Alex: Owners noted: Jordan (routing rule fix + rollout), Lee (runbook + guard), Maria (dashboard + alerts), Sam (postmortem & incident-pattern analysis). Please add PR links in thread.
Sam: Adding a follow-up item: analyze whether our prefix KV cache caused amplified retries when route shifted. Will check cache invalidation traces. ETA 48h.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2312, postmortem template attached: https://redwood/inci/INC-2026-2312/postmortem 
Jordan: Plan for canary: patch LB policy to prefer regional-capacity scoring, add 10% traffic to canary, 15m watch, auto rollback on >1% 5xx. Will open RFC/PR now.
Lee: Runbook note posted: https://redwood/runbooks/lb-egress-splay — initial guard rule and incident steps. Asking oncall to test the checklist during next drill.
Maria: Dashboard draft: https://grafana/redwood/d/egr-splay — includes per-route retries, cross-region latency heatmap, and tokenized sample traces. Will link alert PR shortly.
Sam: Quick pattern note: this is the 3rd similar delta in 9 weeks across different models of edge hardware; suggests intermittent connection drops amplify with our retry knob. Proposing a core action: throttle client retry backoff + prefix caching improvements.
Alex: Good plan. Let's sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC for a 30m remediation sync. Jordan/Lee/Maria/Sam — please confirm availability and add action items to INC-2026-2312.
Jordan: Confirmed.
Lee: Confirmed.
Maria: Confirmed.
Sam: Confirmed, will bring initial triage notes.
Alex: I'll close the loop after the sync with an action-item tracker. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
